text: {"name":"catalog_fields","description":"One field of a catalog's schema: a stable identifier, a label that may change, a type that never changes, and type settings.","owner":"Catalogs","classification":"CONFIDENTIAL","lifecycle":"Saved as part of the whole ordered field list. text: {"name":"layout_areas","description":"One area of a layout: its rectangle in canvas units, stacking order, appearance, audio and kind, and for catalog areas the view's
